name: Hem
tagline: Clothes and small goods, chosen for the cloth.
parking: Free two-hour parking on Linden Street and behind the library.
hours_note: Open late until 8 pm on the first Thursday of the month.

services.name: Alterations
services.description: Hems, sleeves and waists taken in by Ruth at the back counter, usually within the week.

services.name: Fitting appointments
services.description: An hour in the shop before opening, with the rails pulled for your size and what you need.

services.name: Gift cards
services.description: Any amount, wrapped in tissue at the counter or posted in a card the same day.

principles.title: We meet the maker.
principles.body: Every label on the rail is a workshop we have visited, or a person we have sat down with. If we cannot say where it was made, we do not stock it.

principles.title: We buy small.
principles.body: One or two of each size, and rarely the same piece twice. It means gaps on the rail, and it means your coat is not everyone’s coat.

principles.title: We fix what we sell.
principles.body: Hems, buttons, a re-wax, a de-pill — anything bought here is mended here, for as long as you have it.

art_direction.identity: The shop as a mill swatch book: cool card-stock grey pages, cloth cut with pinking shears (zig-zag masked edges on colour fields and chips), numbered colourways, and garments photographed on a wooden hanger against a pale wall in daylight.
art_direction.type: Funnel Display 500–600 for every heading, piece name and price, set large with tight tracking; Funnel Sans for body and interface text at 1rem with a relaxed line height. Prices, colour numbers and hours use tabular numerals.
art_direction.color: Committed lilac field (field) owns whole regions — the hero, the colour card, the closing band — and is never a text tint. Canvas card grey is the dominant neutral, ink for text in two tiers. Buttons are primary (ink). Chartreuse (spot) is a thread only: the new-in dot and the selected-swatch tick. Photographs carry every other colour.
art_direction.signature: The colour card — numbered, pinked fabric chips; choosing one shows the piece made in that cloth with its composition, mill and price. Keep it on the homepage and change the chips with the season.
art_direction.voice: Plain, warm and specific about cloth, fit and where things are made. Short sentences. No exclamation marks, no 'curated', no 'elevate'.
